text.description_html:
Acorn ASIB1, Box of 15 -- 1-1/4” x 12 Pyramid Head Combo Screws

This is a box of replacement screws for the 15-5/8 Inch Bean Tip Smooth Iron Heavy Strap Hinge. Packaged contains 1-1/4”x12 Pyramid head combo stainless steel screws with black finish quantity 15.

Features of the 1-1/4” x 12 Pyramid Head Combo Screws:

  • Screw Size: 1-1/4” x 12
  • Head: Pyramid Head Combo
  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Black

Sold as a Box of 15 Screws
